name: API Performance & Scalability Architecture
description: Designing platform-wide API performance standards, scalability policies, and capacity planning frameworks. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: Backend's be_api_design.rate_limiting_throttling covers implementing Redis token bucket algorithms and coding rate limiter middleware for a single service (implementation); Backend's be_scalability_resilience covers circuit breakers, retry backoff, and connection pooling at the application layer (implementation). API Design's api_performance_scalability covers defining organization-wide rate limiting quota policies, SLA/SLO-driven latency budgets across API tiers, CDN edge distribution strategies, and capacity planning models that govern how all APIs perform and scale (strategic/architectural decision-making). The backend developer writes the rate limiter; the API designer defines the quota tiers, SLAs, and throttling policies that the limiter enforces.

subskills.name: Rate Limiting & Quota Policy Design
subskills.description: Designing tiered rate limiting and quota policies at the platform level — defining quota tiers per API consumer class (free/pro/enterprise), burst allowance policies, quota header standards (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset), and overage handling strategies.

subskills.name: API Caching Strategy Architecture
subskills.description: Architecting multi-layer API caching strategies — CDN edge caching policies, API gateway cache rules, surrogate key (cache tag) invalidation, Vary header strategies for personalized content, and cache warming procedures for high-traffic API launches.

subskills.name: Pagination & Cursor Strategy Standards
subskills.description: Defining platform-wide pagination strategy standards — when cursor-based vs offset pagination is mandated, maximum page size limits, cursor encoding standards, total count computation policies (exact vs estimated), and deep pagination prevention rules.

subskills.name: Payload Optimization & Compression Standards
subskills.description: Establishing payload optimization standards — response compression policies (gzip, Brotli), sparse fieldsets and field selection standards, envelope vs flat response format decisions, binary serialization considerations, and maximum payload size governance.

subskills.name: API Latency Budgeting & SLA/SLO Design
subskills.description: Designing API latency budgets and SLA/SLO frameworks — p50/p95/p99 latency targets per API tier, error budget allocation, latency breakdown across gateway-service-database layers, SLO-driven alerting thresholds, and API performance SLA contracts for external consumers.

subskills.name: CDN & Edge API Distribution
subskills.description: Architecting CDN and edge computing strategies for API distribution — edge caching rules for API responses, geographic routing policies, edge function computation (Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge), API response localization at the edge, and cache purge orchestration.

subskills.name: Connection Management & Multiplexing Policies
subskills.description: Designing API connection management standards — HTTP/2 multiplexing policies, connection pooling governance at the gateway level, keep-alive timeout standards, connection draining during deployments, and WebSocket connection limit policies.

subskills.name: API Capacity Planning & Traffic Modeling
subskills.description: Conducting API capacity planning — traffic forecasting models, peak-to-average ratio analysis, infrastructure scaling triggers, load testing-driven capacity validation, API usage analytics for demand prediction, and cost-per-request efficiency modeling.

subskills.name: Throttling & Backpressure Pattern Governance
subskills.description: Designing platform-wide throttling and backpressure policies — adaptive throttling algorithms, priority queue-based request scheduling, load shedding decision frameworks, graceful degradation API response standards (HTTP 503 with Retry-After), and cascading failure prevention policies.
